column3: Starlet Motel then Moses garage, Port Gellhorn

column4: Open trunk of pink PRTYGRL car (another wreck stacked above). Inspect victim; report to Kelly County Tip Line. column3: Northern Port Gellhorn abandoned trailer park
column4: Under rusted water tower find pale blue-green trailer. Lift loose floorboard on right and report second victim. Patrick Murray: west of Hank's Waffles, enter the trailer nearest the water tower fence; a barking dog is reported by the doorway. The linked map image shows all three victim sites. GTA6GPS plots a missing-tourist marker near Hank's Waffles at X -6337, Y 4557, consistent with the trailer-park clue. Confirm the victim in the trailer. The trailer is beyond the water tower if approaching from the south. Inspect the floor in the green trailer.\nArea sweep (Port Gellhorn): Cards / ED Comics Universe - Funny Bones (Orange) (ID 1197).

column3: Marsh west of Port Gellhorn near Wild Hog Point
column4: At broken leaning tree beside small marsh lake, inspect half-sunken rusty station wagon; report third victim. Beware alligators. Donald Miller: locate the C-shaped pond between the town and airstrip, just before the Wild Hog Point bridge. The linked map image shows all three victim sites. The map shows a small pond beside the airstrip. Approach on foot from the road to the west.

column3: Moses garage warehouse; abandoned mine near Mount Kalaga
column4: Return after 3 tip calls. Spoilers: go in ALONE to trigger partner kidnapping and mine rescue; follow phone message, get crowbar, free partner and confront Alvan West. Glasses are route-dependent. The follow-up starts after returning to the trophy room; the mine is in the Kalaga Reservoir area of Lummox County. Completing the mission reportedly increases the protagonists' relationship. Alternate walkthrough reports both protagonists must be active for the final tip-line call; then enter as Lucia. Solo versus paired entry may change the finale. Save before returning; Chapter 2 cleanup is recommended because later availability is disputed.\nArea sweep (Mount Kalaga): Standout Vehicles - Western Dirt Rocket Zombie Bobber (ID 2505).
